excluded.reason: shared escaping helper used by other layouts; the flaw is the layout that relies on it for XML

note: Log4j1XmlLayout lives in log4j-1.2-api, not the listed log4j-core; formatTo writes the event XML and is present in 2.7, 2.17.0 and 2.25.3. The layout is chosen by name, either directly or as org.apache.log4j.xml.XMLLayout through the Log4j 1 config bridge, so no sink reached proves nothing.
